input: Assemble the flat-pack bookshelf in the hallway

gold.taskTitle: Assemble flat-pack bookshelf in the hallway
gold.taskDescription: Assemble a flat-pack bookshelf and place it in the hallway.

questions.title: What brand or model is the bookshelf?
questions.description: Knowing the brand or model helps identify the exact instructions and parts involved.

questions.title: Is the bookshelf still in its box or already unboxed?
questions.description: Understanding the current state of the bookshelf determines where in the process to start.

questions.title: Do you have the instruction manual and all listed parts?
questions.description: Confirming the manual and parts are present avoids mid-assembly blockers.

questions.title: Which tools do you currently have available at home?
questions.description: Knowing available tools reveals whether anything needs to be sourced before starting.

questions.title: How wide and tall is the hallway space for the bookshelf?
questions.description: Confirming the available space ensures the assembled bookshelf will fit as intended.

questions.title: Will you be assembling it alone or with someone helping?
questions.description: Some flat-pack furniture requires a second person for safe assembly, especially for tall units.

questions.title: By when do you need the bookshelf fully assembled?
questions.description: A deadline or target time helps structure the plan and prioritise the task appropriately.
